ideas.pitch: A consumer-facing health platform that instantly analyzes health insurance denial letters, flags bad-faith reasoning against policy documents, and generates appeal packets.
ideas.problem_statement: Health & Wellness domain challenge involving patient advocacy and medical navigation.
ideas.title: ClaimShield: AI Health Insurance Denial Explainer & Appeal Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Health & Wellness domain with a clear, consumer-centric focus addresses judges' criteria for real-world practicality and impactful user experience, drawing from proven agentic workflow strategies.

ideas.pitch: An interactive smart city and sustainability dashboard for urban commuter routing and automated campus waste bin optimization.
ideas.problem_statement: Sustainability / Smart Cities domain challenge focusing on local environmental footprint tracking.
ideas.title: EcoRoute MPSTME: Smart Campus Carbon & Waste Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the Sustainability / Smart Cities track and leverages local campus relevance, ensuring judges immediately understand the practical utility and visual design choices.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-first FinTech interface providing micro-budgeting insights and automated emergency savings pools tailored for gig economy workers.
ideas.problem_statement: FinTech domain challenge focusing on financial inclusion and digital banking experience.
ideas.title: FinLit Micro-App: Gamified Financial Literacy for Gig Workers
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the FinTech domain with high visual design polish and immediate user empathy, which directly targets the designathon's core scoring metrics of UX and creativity.

ideas.pitch: A localized environmental monitoring interface that maps waterlogging risks and local drainage health metrics across Mumbai neighborhoods in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: Sustainability / Smart Cities domain challenge focusing on urban resilience and municipal infrastructure.
ideas.title: AquaSense Mumbai: Urban Flood and Water Quality Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a hyper-local problem relevant to Mumbai and NMIMS MPSTME judges, making the practicality and presentation resonate strongly with the evaluation panel.

ideas.pitch: An empathetic UI/UX mobile web design offering micro-assessments, peer support circles, and clinical resource navigation for college students.
ideas.problem_statement: Health & Wellness domain challenge focusing on accessible mental health resources.
ideas.title: AuraCare: Mental Wellness Companion for Students
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles student stress—a problem the judges and peers feel themselves in the room—and stands out through exceptional empathy-driven UI/UX design.
